cohort: 90 mother-infant pairs participating in a South African birth cohort
finding: Meconium bacterial profiles, dominated by Proteobacteria, were distinct from maternal faeces, which were dominated by Firmicutes and Actinobacteria, and HIV exposure was associated with higher faecal bacterial diversity and lower proportions of Bifidobacterium in infants.
mod_finding: Maternal faecal bacterial profiles were influenced by mode of delivery.
